plainTranslation: Your drive grates against your identity. Irritable, impatient, spoiling for friction. The push is real but misfires. Move the body, do the hard task, don't take the bait on conflict.
policy: Transit-to-natal entries are ordered: transiting planet to natal point. Do not apply same-moment aspect exclusions. Interpret as an active pressure or opening, not a guaranteed event.
